proposals.evidence: DEDR 3103 directly gives Tamil talai, Malayalam tala, Kannada tale, Tulu tare, Gondi tala/talla, Parji tel and Gadaba tallu ‘head’. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.
